title: Interaction Patterns: Let the Model Ask

questions.prompt: You ask a chat model to secretly pick a number and tell you higher or lower. What actually happens?

options.text: The model stores the number in hidden memory until the game ends
There is no hidden number; nothing unwritten carries between turns, so hints may be inconsistent
The model encrypts the number in its weights
The chat app automatically creates a secure random number

questions.explanation: Only the visible conversation carries forward. Secret state and randomness should live in your code.

questions.prompt: Which are good ways to stop a flipped interaction? Select all that apply.

options.text: A question budget, such as at most 6 questions
A completion condition, such as 'when you know my budget and dates'
Trusting the model to know when you're bored

questions.explanation: Budgets, completion conditions, and exit words give the interaction a clear end. In apps, also enforce a hard cap in code.

questions.prompt: A fixed marker such as "BRIEF:" that a model outputs to tell your program it's finished is called a ____.
questions.explanation: A sentinel lets code detect the end of a phase reliably instead of guessing from free text.

questions.prompt: What best describes the Cognitive Verifier pattern?

options.text: The model checks its own grammar
The model generates sub-questions for your question, collects your answers, and combines them into a final answer
The model refuses questions it can't verify online

questions.explanation: Cognitive Verifier decomposes one question into the facts it depends on, then uses your answers to respond more accurately.

questions.prompt: Match each pattern to its best use.

pairs.right: One fuzzy question that depends on unstated facts
Apps deciding when to clarify before acting

questions.explanation: Each pattern shifts who drives the conversation for a different purpose.

questions.prompt: Order the parts of the Flipped Interaction format.
questions.explanation: The format is: Ask me questions about [X] until [condition Y] is met. Ask [Z] questions at a time.
